title: The Long Way Round
summary: Maudry Fenn keeps the Tired Mule in Thornwick. The carters won't take the barrows road past the walking dead any more, and the long way round goes on the price of everything she pours. She wants the dead in the Old Barrows knocked back.

steps.journal: Go down into the Old Barrows, the burial mounds out past Thornwick's fields. Hold four waves there, in any rooms, and open one of their chests.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Old Barrows
Chests opened in the Old Barrows

ready: Go back to Maudry Fenn at the Tired Mule in Thornwick and tell her.
done: You knocked back the dead in the Old Barrows for Maudry Fenn. The carters complain about something else now.
